\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
This paper presents a Harness-controlled research runtime with bounded retrieval,
deterministic verification, durable evidence, and replayable publication records.
\end{abstract}

\section{Introduction}
Research agents need auditable claim support. The Harness owns workflow routing,
authorization, quality decisions, memory writes, and publication while the language
worker produces schema-bound candidate content.

\section{Method}
The method executes PLAN, EXECUTE, and VERIFY phases under bounded retry and replan
budgets. Retrieval gathers method evidence and claim support from the accepted paper
source. Deterministic gates verify evidence lineage before artifacts are published.

\section{Experiments}
The experiment compares the controlled runtime with an uncontrolled baseline on a
recorded evaluation dataset. Claim verification accuracy reaches 0.91 while durable
trace reconstruction preserves every gate decision and source reference.

\section{Conclusion}
The limitation is that the local durable backend targets one host. Multi-host
scheduling and vector retrieval require separately configured production services.
